message.content:
This appears to be from a CBP ruling or an antidumping scope on "dried crustacean eggs" from Thailand. The candidate headings are:

- 0511.91: products of fish or crustaceans, unfit for human consumption. Within it, 0511.91.00 covers "Products of fish or crustaceans, molluscs or other aquatic invertebrates; dead animals of chapter 3," and the statistical suffixes are 0511.91.0010 (fish eggs/roe?), 0511.91.0020, 0511.91.0030, 0511.91.0040 (brine shrimp and eggs), and 0511.91.0090 (other).
- 0106.19 or 0106.90: live animals. The eggs are dormant but viable, so this is arguable.
- 0307 and 0306: crustaceans, including dried ones. Brine shrimp eggs are typically classified in 0511.91.

I recall that the HTSUS 0511.91 statistical suffixes are: 0511.91.0010 Fish eggs, roe, milt; 0511.91.0020 Brine shrimp and eggs; 0511.91.0030 Other fish products; 0511.91.0090 Other. Fairy shrimp, moina, and daphnia eggs are not brine shrimp, so "Other" fits best, which is 0511.91.0090.
